# DelphX Capital Markets Inc.

> DelphX Capital Markets Inc. (TSXV: DELX | OTCQB: DPXCF) is a publicly traded fintech-focused capital markets solutions company headquartered in New York and Toronto. We build structured credit solutions (Credit Rating Securities - CRS), private placement advisory services, and fully collateralized hedged cryptocurrency structured products (QCS).

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.delphx.com): Overview of DelphX's structured credit, private placements, and institutional onboarding process.
- [About](https://www.delphx.com/about): Three dimensions (Structured Credit, Private Placement Advisory, QCS), Keys to the Story, and market metrics.
- [Investors](https://www.delphx.com/investors): Investor communications, white paper, presentation, and investment thesis.
- [Team](https://www.delphx.com/team): Leadership and board of directors.
- [Press Releases](https://www.delphx.com/press-releases): Official corporate announcements and news releases.
- [Media Resources](https://www.delphx.com/resources): Podcasts and video interviews featuring CEO Patrick Wood.
- [Contact](https://www.delphx.com/contact): Contact form and office locations in Toronto, New York, and Somerset, NJ.
